def blocks(frame):
    out={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in ('N','R','b') and n['pixels']>=12:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rows)<50:
                cols=[p[1] for p in b]; out[c]=(min(cols),max(cols))
    return out
print("before:", blocks(current_frame))

print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over')})
print("after:", blocks(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
